samples.label: Alerts
samples.description: GitHub-style alerts: built-in variants, custom titles, a custom variant and alerts inside other blocks.

samples.label: Footnotes
samples.description: Numbered, named and inline footnotes with hover previews; attachFootnotes scrolls and highlights the target.

samples.label: Code blocks
samples.description: Titles, line numbers, highlighted, inserted and deleted lines, and code groups; attachCode wraps lines and switches groups.

samples.label: Spoilers
samples.description: Click or press Enter to reveal; front-matter data-* values come back only for the names in allowedDataAttributes.

samples.label: Spanning tables
samples.description: Column spans with ||, row spans with ^^, a caption, multi-row headers and a footer row.

samples.label: Task lists
samples.description: interactiveCheckboxes: 'attached' boxes stay read-only until attachLists runs; lineOffset maps each toggle to its line in the file, which the sample rewrites.

samples.label: Tabs and timeline
samples.description: Keyboard-accessible tabs (attachTabs) and a dated timeline whose events keep their calendar date in every time zone.

samples.label: Typography
samples.description: Smart quotes, dashes, ellipses and fractions, with classes skipped and typographicTransform for HTML you already have; quotes and backticks are separate groups.

samples.label: Linked notes
samples.description: A note page: [toc], ==highlights==, [[wiki links]] with a resolve callback, and attachSourceMap stamping data-line and heading ids.

samples.label: Labels and i18n
samples.description: Every user-visible string comes from a labels option: alert titles, footnote heading, spoiler hint, timeline and TOC text in Spanish.

samples.label: Sanitized output
samples.description: Renders through an Angular-like allow-list sanitizer first, then attaches the runtimes: the default markup keeps working.

samples.label: Theme tokens
samples.description: Seven extensions restyled at once by the --mx-* base tokens on :root: presets, color pickers and the CSS they set.
